devdoc.details: This is a port from X-Domain Dai implementation: https://www.diffchecker.com/XeqEiDcn/ with additional features:      - Actors with owner access (`wards`) can update `name` and `symbol`.

params.data: The new value of the parameter.
params.what: The parameter being changed. One of: "name", "symbol".

params.value: The amount transfered. Note that `value` may be zero.

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().details: To prevent replay attacks after potential chain splits, the cached domain separator is used only if the current chain ID matches the cached chain ID. Otherwise, the domain separator is recalculated every time.

returns._0: The keccak256 hash of the EIP-712 identifier.

approve(address,uint256).details: Emits an {Approval} event.IMPORTANT: Beware that changing an allowance with this method brings the risk that someone may use both the old and the new allowance by unfortunate transaction ordering. One possible solution to mitigate this race condition is to first reduce the spender's allowance to 0 and set the desired value afterwards: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/20#issuecomment-263524729

returns._0: Always `true` if the transaction did not revert.

burn(address,uint256).details: If `from` != `msg.sender`, it uses the allowance mechanism.Emits a {Transfer} event with `to` set to the zero address.

params.from: The origin for the burnt tokens.
params.value: The amount of tokens to burn.

file(bytes32,string).details: There are no mechanisms to prevent governance from changing token parameters more than once.      We assume that the enforcement will be handled off-chain through governance artifacts.

params.data: The updated value for the parameter.
params.what: The parameter being changed. One of: "name", "symbol".

mint(address,uint256).details: Only authorized parties can call this function.`to` must not be the zero address.Emits a {Transfer} event with `from` set to the zero address.

params.to: The destination for the minted tokens.
params.value: The amount of tokens to mint.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,b.details: Emits an {Approval} event.IMPORTANT: The same issues {IERC20-approve} has related to transaction ordering also apply here.

params.deadline: Until when the permit is valid. MUST be a timestamp in the future.
params.owner: The account setting the allowance through permit.
params.signature: The signature for the permit. MUST use `owner`'s current nonce (see {nonces}).
params.spender: The account receiving the allowance through permit. CANNOT be the zero address.
params.value: The amount for allowance through permit.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Emits an {Approval} event.IMPORTANT: The same issues {IERC20-approve} has related to transaction ordering also apply here.

params.deadline: Until when the permit is valid. MUST be a timestamp in the future.
params.owner: The account setting the allowance through permit.
params.spender: The account receiving the allowance through permit. CANNOT be the zero address.
params.value: The amount for allowance through permit.
The amount of tokens to transfer.

_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.details: Returns the domain separator used in the encoding of the signature for {permit}, as defined by {EIP712}.

decimals.details: The number of decimal places for the token.

deploymentChainId.details: The chain ID of the chain in which the token has been deployed.

nonces.details: This value must be included whenever a signature is generated for {permit}.Every successful call to {permit} increases `owner`'s nonce by one.

devdoc.title: SDAO: SubDAO-level governance token.

Approval(address,address,uint256).notice: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).notice: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`).

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().notice: Calculates the EIP-712 domain separator for permits.

allowance(address,address).notice: The remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. allowance[owner][spender]

approve(address,uint256).notice: Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over `msg.sender` tokens.

balanceOf(address).notice: Returns the amount of tokens owned by `account`. balanceOf[account]

burn(address,uint256).notice: Destroys `amount` tokens and assigns them to `to`, decreasing the total supply.

deny(address).notice: Revokes `usr` admin access from this contract.

mint(address,uint256).notice: Creates `amount` tokens and assigns them to `to`, increasing the total supply.

nonces(address).notice: Provides replay attack protection for ERC20 Permits. nonces[owner]

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,b.notice: Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over `owner`'s tokens, given `owner`'s signed approval.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.notice: Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over `owner`'s tokens, given `owner`'s signed approval.

rely(address).notice: Grants `usr` admin access to this contract.

totalSupply().notice: Returns the amount of tokens in existence.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: Moves `amount` tokens from `from` to `to` using the allowance mechanism.

wards(address).notice: Addresses with owner access on this contract. `wards[usr]`
